items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: I learned a boy how to play, they called him Sidney Williams. He made a nice trumpet player, but he's dead now.

ctx.x: Is that the Whitney Avenue canal or Whitney Avenue, that canal you're talking about or what avenue?

Yeah. That's on New Nez, on New Nez Street. Oh yeah. That's big canal there. And a graveyard right by the, I lived in that last house, right by the graveyard. I used to go in the early that night, I was scared, you know. Scared of ghosts. I was a little boy, I remember that this as well, and I got sick. And they sent me, my cousin sent me back to Plackham, to my mother, you see. I got around there and got me up a nut, little man, started playing around there. And I learned a boy how to play, they called him…
When was the first time you ever heard Louis Armstrong and Kid René in those songs?
